statements: Our emails go out as HTML now, and customer names broke one last week. Add renderHtml(template, data, options) to src/template.mjs, which fills in a template the way renderText does and makes the result safe as HTML.
{{{name}}} puts a value in unescaped, but only for the names in options.trusted. For anything else it is treated like {{name}}.
renderText keeps working exactly as it does now, because plain-text emails must not show entities.
The new behaviour has tests in test/. Keep the change focused on what this ticket needs.
brief: Add an HTML renderer to the template module, as the numbered statements describe. Follow the conventions already in the code and change only what the ticket needs.
